name: DOHMH Cryptosporidiosis by Race/Ethnicity, Age Group, and Borough of Residence
description:
This dataset from the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) contains annual counts and rates of reported cryptosporidiosis cases, broken down by race/ethnicity, age group, and borough of residence. It covers the years 2000 through 2025, with each row representing a combination of year and demographic group. Case counts appear alongside rates in parentheses for each age band (under 1 year, 1–4, 5 years, 5–9, 10–19, 20–44, 45–59, and 60 and older) and for each borough (Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island) plus a citywide total. Race/ethnicity categories include Hispanic, White non-Hispanic, Black non-Hispanic, Asian/Pacific Islander, Other, Unknown, and Total.

The data can be used to track trends in cryptosporidiosis over time, compare burden across racial and ethnic groups
